The '''Quickflash burning gel''', also known as the "shipwright's spare key," is an electrochemical hull-breaching agent synthesized and produced by the [[Corellian Chemical Corporation/Legends|Corellian Chemical Corporation]]. The burning gel's primary purpose to burn through doors, hatchways, and machine compartments that are otherwise inaccessible, though it is also commonly used to cut holes in damaged or derelict [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="ETU" />

When the gel is used, it burns through almost any substance and in any environment. Contrary to [[Cutting torch/Legends|cutting torches]] and welders, it emits no [[Fire/Legends|flame]] and requires no [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], allowing its use in the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. These qualities allowed it to be very popular among salvage crews, [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologists]], and other less savory characters.<ref name="ETU" />

The gel has two primary components: a stable, extremely caustic [[Acid/Legends|acid]] suspended in a clear gel that sticks to almost any surface and a pair of thin electrodes. Both are contained in a dispenser unit that includes a refillable tank of gel and electrode wire, a very small [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]], and a pistol-grip applicator as well as the necessary wiring. Once a desired amount of burning gel has been used, the power generator activates and runs a quick, high-powered charge through the gel to activate the acid, which immediately begins eating away at whatever it has been applied to.<ref name="ETU" />
